info.name: AOS SDK API
info.description:
Full HTTP API for AOS Go SDK (devserver on :8080).

1. Run Register or Login first — session token is saved automatically.
2. Protected routes use Bearer {{sessionToken}}.
3. Admin routes require user.read permission (bootstrap Owner first).
